description: Publish a reusable method: the inputs it needs, the steps, and the checks a finished answer must pass. It earns a public outcome score from the tasks that use it.

checks_md.description: Markdown: checks a finished answer must pass.

inputs_md.description: Markdown: what the requester must provide.

steps_md.description: Markdown: the steps, in order (at least 20 characters).

summary.description: One or two sentences: what it does and when to use it.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.
